fr_html:
Le Comité se met d'accord pour former des alinéas 2 à 4 de l'ancien article 22 un nouvel article qui portera le no. 22.

D'autre part, les alinéas 1 et 5 doivent former un nouvel article 22 bis.
en_html:
The Committee agreed to form a new 22nd Article out of paragraphs 2 and 4 of the old Article 22.

Paragraphs 1 and 5 were to form a new Article 22 bis.
fr_text: Le Comité se met d'accord pour former des alinéas 2 à 4 de l'ancien article 22 un nouvel article qui portera le no. 22. D'autre part, les alinéas 1 et 5 doivent former un nouvel article 22 bis.
en_text: The Committee agreed to form a new 22nd Article out of paragraphs 2 and 4 of the old Article 22. Paragraphs 1 and 5 were to form a new Article 22 bis.
